comment: No source is published for this plugin. The jacks carry no family: a multiple passes on whatever is patched into it, so no colour is the honest answer. The port names in the lines are the maker's own configInput and configOutput strings, which are "Port 1 (source)", "Port 5 (source / break)" and "Port 2" through "Port 8"; nothing is lettered on the panel itself. The only context-menu item is "Panel skin", offering "Black" and "Silver" and saved to the patch as panelSkin; it changes which of res/AI001-black-v6.svg and res/AI001-silver-v6.svg is drawn and nothing else, so it is left out of the lines. An unpatched source leaves its three outputs at one channel of 0V rather than disconnected: process() writes the channel count 1 and a zero voltage. No numeric constants are quoted in any line, so check_numbers.py has nothing to test here.
